warning.titlePre: Range Rover Evoque D165 Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your Evoque D165 has the Ingenium AJ200D or AJ150D diesel — across both the L538 and L551 generations — timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks are well-documented patterns on this engine family, confirmed by multiple specialist sources and owner forums. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium diesel rebuild.

The Evoque P200 and P250 petrol variants use a different engine family — the Ingenium AJ200P petrol — which doesn't share this specific diesel pattern. The P300e PHEV variant also uses its own powertrain configuration.
warning.source: Source: shared Ingenium diesel family pattern (Discovery Sport/Evoque platform, per G-BRF). Petrol and PHEV variants explicitly excluded from this claim
